prompt_head:
Job: Forward Deployed Engineer (Fort Lauderdale/Miami) at TribalScale
<requirements>
- (required) Professional experience building and deploying production-grad

output.summary: Systems architect with 4+ years delivering production‑grade AI‑agent platforms and full‑stack applications. Designed a six‑stage agent pipeline that enforces verification to prevent hallucinated outputs. Built a Cloudflare‑based operations CRM module for high‑value subscription accounts. Managed $100M+ of federal inventory with perfect audit accuracy while cutting processing time.

bullets.text: Designed a six-stage agent pipeline using Interpretable Context Methodology, enforcing automated verification to prevent hallucinated pricing and claims.
Built tycodes.app, an AI demo generator that creates shoppable 3D scroll demos from URLs in about one minute, deployed on Cloudflare Workers, Workflows, R2 and D1.
Engineered tycodes.dev using edge infrastructure (Vite, React, TS, Tailwind) on Cloudflare Workers, with a Hono Worker running Firecrawl and OpenAI for automated audit and pricing models.
Designed zero-maintenance serverless backends that connect Google Sheets via OAuth, removing the need for dedicated servers.
Engineered Tradecrumb, a multi-signal Python trading engine combining technical indicators, NLP sentiment and political triggers, with backtesting and grid-search optimization.
Architected and deployed linkme-intops, an operations CRM module built with React and TypeScript on Cloudflare Workers, giving staff a dedicated interface for high-value subscription accounts.
Engineered custom data ingestion modules and analytics pipelines for VIP workflows, cutting service delivery times by over 30%.
Designed integration blueprints and live demo environments that reliably onboard high-value enterprise clients onto the core platform.
Led end-to-end modernization from legacy desktop systems to cloud-native web infrastructure, lowering manual data processing overhead by 68%.
Constructed database-layer automated validation pipelines that removed 98% of transactional and invoicing errors.
Managed $100M+ of federal inventory across 12 sites for 8,000+ personnel, maintaining 100% audit accuracy while cutting processing times by 35%.
